name: Last Cut Studio
description: Edit original animated footage into a clean, complete montage under a pictured brief.
natural_language: Assemble the pictured montage. Inspect each source in motion, retain the complete actions in order, remove all slates and cleanup hands, and meet the displayed duration. Preview and export your cut.

metadata.notes: Original procedural paper-theatre footage. Outcome grading checks retained frame intervals, shot identity/order and total duration. Human and agent calibration absent.
